# [J1 — Transparent exopolymer particles and marine gel](../openproblems/J1.md "Transparent exopolymer particles and marine gel")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/openproblem_j1.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-STATUS">**Missing: measurement** - specifically *a new metric over what is already recorded*. TEP, the quantity the hypothesis is about, is recorded in nothing held here. A metric over the optics already recorded can be written down; it cannot be formed in physical units, and if it could it could not be attributed to gel.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-CTDPARAMS">The CTD extract `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` carries [17](../SOURCES.md#F-779d628231) distinct `Parameter` values over its [53,710,760](../SOURCES.md#F-4df017f985) records: Temperatur [7,501,421](../SOURCES.md#F-0ad2b4d9e0) · Salinitet [7,474,645](../SOURCES.md#F-cf5c72a98d) · Oxygen indhold [7,147,012](../SOURCES.md#F-35e37a230f) · Fluorescens [6,783,790](../SOURCES.md#F-3a1131d7c3) · Oxygenmætning [6,598,319](../SOURCES.md#F-1a573ec6ce) · Lysdæmpning [5,217,377](../SOURCES.md#F-3b0f7011a8) · Konduktivitet [5,169,432](../SOURCES.md#F-b1804c5af7) · Vægtfylde [4,329,674](../SOURCES.md#F-0c97d9a36c) · Turbiditet [1,076,915](../SOURCES.md#F-85266abfd1) · FDOM [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-acb2b229c0) · Photometer måling [576,179](../SOURCES.md#F-9529de8510) · Photometer reference [531,071](../SOURCES.md#F-570ef298c6) · pH [237,496](../SOURCES.md#F-9b03a32d66) · Strømhastighed [84,734](../SOURCES.md#F-0d643b815f) · Strømretning [84,572](../SOURCES.md#F-6ec7d27a0f) · Farvestof [4,601](../SOURCES.md#F-2b410c325d) · Dihydrogensulfid [2,601](../SOURCES.md#F-153d19187a).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-CTDPARAMS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The new metric, stated precisely enough to be rejected

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-OPTICS">The archive holds more optics than the monthly panel exposes. `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` carries [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months over [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables, of which one is optical: `fluo`, fluorescence in the relative unit `rel`, on [60,460](../SOURCES.md#F-9ecc204bb2) station-months. Beside fluorescence the raw CTD file carries the three optical channels the metric below uses: `Lysdæmpning`, light attenuation, on [5,217,377](../SOURCES.md#F-3b0f7011a8) records, `Turbiditet` on [1,076,915](../SOURCES.md#F-85266abfd1), and `FDOM`, the fluorescence of dissolved organic matter, on [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-acb2b229c0), from [2021](../SOURCES.md#F-281b3dc6e4) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-70522e245c) only.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-OPTICS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

The metric would be, per cast carrying all four:

> **R = Lysdæmpning − f(Fluorescens, FDOM, Turbiditet)**

attenuation unexplained by the chlorophyll, coloured dissolved matter and particles that are supposed to explain it. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-SHRINK">`RESIDUAL.md` gives the test such a number must pass: **R must shrink by exactly P when a part P is measured out of it.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-SHRINK "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Why it fails

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-PCT">**First, R has no physical units.** The unit column `Enhed` holds `pct` on [11,815,696](../SOURCES.md#F-77356724ba) records - exactly as many as `Lysdæmpning` ([5,217,377](../SOURCES.md#F-3b0f7011a8)) and `Oxygenmætning` ([6,598,319](../SOURCES.md#F-1a573ec6ce)) carry together - and none of its units is a coefficient per metre: the attenuation channel is a percentage transmission, not an attenuation coefficient.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-PCT "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-PATH">A transmission becomes a coefficient only through the path length the light travelled, and no column of the extract records one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-PATH "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-FDOMUNIT">`FDOM`'s [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-acb2b229c0) records match the [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-0063f575ec) in `ppb`, a concentration unit, not an absorption coefficient. The total has no dimension; the parts come from one column that mixes scales.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-FDOMUNIT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-TWOUNITS">That the column mixes scales is visible in the same table: `Konduktivitet`'s [5,169,432](../SOURCES.md#F-b1804c5af7) records are exactly the [4,425,685](../SOURCES.md#F-9f915634f8) in `mS/cm` and the [743,747](../SOURCES.md#F-2d19c086a7) in `mS/m`, and `Vægtfylde`'s [4,329,674](../SOURCES.md#F-0c97d9a36c) exactly the [3,412,290](../SOURCES.md#F-35ee247cde) in `g/l` and the [917,384](../SOURCES.md#F-a4ca594a26) in `kg/m3`: one parameter, two unit labels, told apart only by the unit field of each record.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-TWOUNITS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-VACUOUS">**Second, the shrink-by-P test is vacuous, because P is fitted rather than measured.** Adding FDOM does reduce R - but FDOM's *contribution to attenuation* is the fitted coefficient of the same regression that produces R, not an independent measurement of it. The account is circular in the way `RESIDUAL.md` describes, and `R_new = R_old − P` has no independent `P`. It would become a real test only if the absorption by dissolved matter were measured, and none of the extract's channels measures an absorption.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-VACUOUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-START">**Third, even the ship's own attenuation coefficient depends on how the cast was taken.** In this project's light analysis the growth-season casts whose profile begins above [2](../SOURCES.md#F-5a6a77bc92) m give a median Kd of [0.35](../SOURCES.md#F-f8f56b7f48) and those beginning below it [0.27](../SOURCES.md#F-341b020904); where a cast starts is a matter of how it was taken, not of the water.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-START "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-LYSD">The per-depth `Lysdæmpning` channel escapes that artefact but inherits the first reason instead.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-LYSD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-TRANSP">**And the target's own name is the last objection.** TEP are, in the encyclopaedia's words, *otherwise transparent*: they are counted by staining them with Alcian blue.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-TRANSP "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-PROXY">An optical proxy for them means detecting, inside a residual, a substance that is counted by staining because it is otherwise transparent. Aggregated gel does scatter - TEP form the aggregates known as marine snow - but turbidity is a measure of scattered light, and it is subtracted out before R is formed.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-PROXY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What building it anyway would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-WOULD">It **would** license a description: how much attenuation is unexplained by the three channels meant to explain it, in ranks rather than units, and whether that share has seasonal or station shape.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-NOSCRIPT">No script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-NOSCRIPT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-WOULDNOT">It **would not** license calling the residual gel, TEP or fedtemøg. That is the shrinkage move in `RESIDUAL.md` - naming the leftover after one item on its list - and the list here includes the sondes' calibration, which the extract corrects by a factor other than one on [2,813,137](../SOURCES.md#F-881ec387e1) records, the unrecorded path length, dissolved matter FDOM does not see, and whatever else attenuates light that none of the three channels measures.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-WOULDNOT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The smallest unblocking thing

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-SMALL">**[30](../SOURCES.md#F-75de2d1961) Alcian-blue TEP samples from the rosette on casts already running the four-sensor suite, at stations carrying FDOM.** Not a survey - a calibration: the paired points settle whether R carries any TEP information. A correlation would turn the existing four-sensor casts into a retrospective TEP series; no correlation retires the optical route. The method needs the dye and a spectrophotometer.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-SMALL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-J1-ASK">Cheaper still, and prerequisite to the first reason: **ask ODA for the path length of the instrument behind `Lysdæmpning`.** Without it no attenuation coefficient can be reconstructed from the channel's [5,217,377](../SOURCES.md#F-3b0f7011a8) records.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-J1-ASK "What this claim rests on")</sup>
